title: Cloud Protection and Posture Control (CNAPP): what the captures do not cover

prose.text: No captured Zscaler page describes these offerings {{gap:cp-capture}}. The captured DSPM page covers the cloud storage and compute it scans: [[dspm.overview:marketing-scope]].

Whether Cloud Protection is a pillar that combines CSPM, microsegmentation and workload traffic security is open {{gap:cp-pillar}}. Whether it differs from Cloud Connector by scanning configuration rather than forwarding traffic is open {{gap:cp-vs-connector}}. The Cloud & Branch Connector product is in [[cloud-connector.overview]].

Whether Posture Control is a standalone CNAPP that converges CSPM, CIEM, CWPP, DLP, IaC security, vulnerability management and compliance is open {{gap:cnapp-convergence}}. Whether it scans container images and virtual machines agentlessly across AWS, Azure, GCP and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is open {{gap:cnapp-agentless}}.

Whether it correlates misconfigurations into attack paths is open {{gap:cnapp-attack-paths}}. Whether the standalone identity has narrowed into DSPM and CNAPP messaging is open {{gap:cnapp-redirect}}. How it integrates is open {{gap:cnapp-integration}}.

checks.do: Do not attribute CNAPP or posture-control behavior to DSPM or Cloud Connector; answer that the behavior is open and name the gap.

cp-capture.title: Whether any captured page describes Cloud Protection, Posture Control or CNAPP
cp-capture.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Cloud Protection / Zero Trust Cloud ... Awareness only — no dedicated capture beyond the marketing-page references.' Searches of vendor/zscaler-help and vendor/zscaler-api-specs for CNAPP, CSPM, CIEM, Posture Control and Cloud Protection find no product page. The CSPM matches are admin role names in the ZIA and Cloud & Branch Connector API specs, not this offering.

cp-pillar.title: Whether Cloud Protection is a platform pillar combining CSPM, microsegmentation and workload traffic
cp-pillar.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Pillar offering combining CSPM, microsegmentation, and secure east-west / ingress-egress traffic for workloads in AWS / Azure / on-prem. Marketed as a platform pillar rather than a discrete product.' No captured page describes this pillar.

cp-vs-connector.title: How Cloud Protection differs from Cloud Connector
cp-vs-connector.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Cloud Connector forwards workload traffic; Cloud Protection scans cloud configuration.' No captured page makes this distinction.

cnapp-convergence.title: What the Posture Control CNAPP converges
cnapp-convergence.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'The standalone Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) converges CSPM + CIEM + CWPP + DLP + IaC security + vulnerability management + compliance into one unified platform.' No captured page lists these components.

cnapp-agentless.title: Whether Posture Control scans agentlessly across four clouds
cnapp-agentless.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Agentless: API-based scan of container images in registries and VMs in production. Multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure).' No captured page says this.

cnapp-attack-paths.title: Whether Posture Control correlates misconfigurations into attack paths
cnapp-attack-paths.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Distinguishing capability: correlates seemingly-low-risk individual misconfigurations into composite high-risk attack paths.' The captured DSPM marketing page makes an attack-path correlation claim for DSPM, not for a CNAPP product, so the legacy statement is not supported for Posture Control.

cnapp-redirect.title: Whether Posture Control's identity has narrowed into DSPM and CNAPP messaging
cnapp-redirect.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Marketing page redirects to the broader DSPM / CNAPP messaging; Posture Control's standalone identity has narrowed.' No captured page records a redirect or a change of identity.

cnapp-integration.title: How Posture Control integrates with customer environments
cnapp-integration.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'No SDK surfaced; agentless API scanning is the integration model.' No captured page describes an integration model for Posture Control.
